answer: To deter Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic stake burning for concurrent agent registrations. Staking tiers index collateral durability: ephemeral agents burn ferrous scrap value, verified nodes pledge marble reserves, and elite autonomous actors commit rare jade bonds. When an entity registers n identities, required burn scales as O(n^2), imposing superlinear attacker cost that rapidly renders mass identity forgery economically unviable.
